title: Offscreen documents can't message content scripts directly → relay through background
trigger: Offscreen document needs to send debug logs or data to content script (or vice versa)
principle: chrome.runtime.sendMessage from offscreen documents only reaches the background service worker, NOT content scripts. Content scripts require chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, msg). To bridge offscreen→content, relay through background: offscreen sends to background, background forwards via chrome.tabs.sendMessage or writes to chrome.storage.local for content script to poll.

cases.context: Offscreen document sends debug logs via chrome.runtime.sendMessage expecting content script to receive them — content script listener never fires

applyFor: Debug logging from offscreen documents to DevTools-visible context
Any architecture where offscreen needs to reach content script context
Relay patterns for contexts with restricted chrome.runtime.sendMessage scope
